comparison.objective: Pack five lunch items with two perishables touching a flat ice pack; candidate breaks and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object packing, orientation, and deliberate adjacency placement versus coaxial mandrel control, hammering, withdrawal, and millimetre-scale pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Ice pack flat, yogurt upright, sandwich flat, each perishable within 5 mm of the pack, with no perishable misplaced versus four safe fractures and four tangs in the tray.
comparison.reason: Contact-aware packing shares only generic placement; it lacks the candidate's impact-fracture mechanism and fragment-accounting requirement.
